summary: Confirmed on koa.com: $65-102 (cheapest type, May weeknight to July Saturday; June weeknight $72), full hookups and 50-amp, pull-throughs, phone 518-946-7878. Added 45-ft max, Wi-Fi, general store, season (May to October, no exact dates), booking link. Note trimmed of hookup/pull-through/price text and the RV Life rating line. Not stated: site count, exact season dates, showers by name.
flags: Price gate: base $65-72 on weeknights and $102 on a July Saturday (cheapest type a 23-ft motorhome is offered), over US$50; passes on the gateway exception: Lake Placid (attraction) 17 km away per gateways.py. The family has not stayed here.

Weak waterfront lead: the entry is 'not waterfront', while KOA sells 'Riverside' site types 'near the beautiful Ausable River' and lists 'access to the Ausable River'; worth a look at the Riverside sites on imagery.
